title: Fable 5.2 costs $8 per million input tokens. Anthropic still points most work to Opus.
friendlyTitle: The strongest Claude costs less. Most jobs should still start smaller.
summary: Anthropic released Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2 on 9 November. They are the same model. Fable, with cybersecurity and biology safeguards, is the general release. Mythos stays inside approved life-sciences and cybersecurity programs. Anthropic says it is up to 30 percent faster than 5.1, at $8 per million input tokens and $40 per million output tokens. A faster mode costs double.
friendlySummary: Anthropic released Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2 on 9 November. They are the same model. Fable is the one most people can use. Mythos is only for approved science and security teams. Anthropic says it is up to 30 percent faster than the last version, at $8 per million input tokens and $40 per million output tokens.
whyItMatters: Anthropic says most coding and knowledge work should still start on Opus 5.5, and move to Fable only when the job is open-ended. On its FrontierCode test, Fable 5.2 at high effort scored about level with Opus 5.5's best, for roughly half the cost per task. A higher score on that test is not a reason to put the expensive model on every chat.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Anthropic says most everyday coding should still start on a smaller model, Opus 5.5. Use Fable when the job is hard and open-ended. A better score on one test does not mean you should pay the higher price for every chat.
